parsed_json.up: Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value from activities on target CHEMBL1958. Join target_dictionary on assays.tid, activities on assays.assay_id, molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno, and compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter to standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
